artworks.title: Execution
artworks.description: This is a drawing featuring historical figures surrounded by ornate decorations. The composition includes figures in classical attire gathered in a dynamic arrangement. The foreground features detailed figures with muscular physiques, helmets, and staffs or spears. The background has swirling floral patterns. Below the central scene, there is a border with floral designs and a winged face.

artworks.title: General
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an octagonal emblem featuring a central scene surrounded by decorative borders. The central part of the emblem contains a complex and abstract depiction. Surrounding this central depiction are ornate borders filled with swirling, floral motifs. The line work is detailed and dense, giving the emblem an elaborate appearance. The style and design suggest a historical or classical influence.

artworks.title: Landscape
artworks.description: The image displays a top-down view of an intricate design with a central circular scene surrounded by detailed decorative motifs. In the center, there is a rural landscape with a small house, trees, and a body of water. The design includes swirling floral and leaf patterns in a monochrome color palette of blacks and beiges.

artworks.title: Landscape with an Obelisk
artworks.description: The image displays a circular scene surrounded by an ornate border. The perspective is from above, looking into the circular depiction, showing a pastoral or village setting. In the inner circle, there are architectural elements like small houses and a tower with a body of water between them. In the distance, there is a tall spire or tree rising above the rest. The horizon is where the structures meet the sky. The texture within the central depiction consists of fine brushstrokes or etching marks, creating a stippled effect. The color palette is monochromatic with black ink on a cream-colored background. The outer border is decorated with swirling patterns and human figures.

artworks.title: Lovers
artworks.description: The image features a circular scene viewed from behind a couple walking side by side. The horizon is at the couple's waist level, showing small buildings surrounded by trees. The fine, detailed brushstrokes create depth through an etching style. The monochromatic color palette uses shades of black on a cream-colored background, enhancing contrast. A tree is visible on the right edge, framing the couple walking towards the buildings.

artworks.title: Lovers
artworks.description: The image depicts a circular illustration resembling a clock face with Roman numerals around the border. Two figures in historical attire are positioned in the center, with a large globe or structure further back. The sky shows horizontal lines and bird-like shapes. The artwork is monochromatic in varying shades of black, gray, and parchment color, with intricate line work and hatchings for texture.

artworks.title: Lucretia?
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an ornate circular object with mythological figures and decorative patterns. The central part of the drawing depicts intricately detailed figures set against a backdrop that includes architectural elements like a domed building and a stone archway. Surrounding this central scene is a border filled with floral motifs and fantastical creatures or figures. The outermost circle is a combination of elaborate designs with heads of cherubs or spirits. The use of shading and line work suggests depth and dimension in this highly detailed artwork.

artworks.title: Man on Horseback
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a mythological scene with decorative borders. The central depiction is of a warrior in armor, engaged in a dynamic pose amidst other figures. The figures are surrounded by swirling, ornate designs that fill the octagonal frame. The background includes architectural elements such as domes and spires. The composition is enclosed within an elaborate border filled with intricate scrolls.

artworks.title: The Resurrection
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a scene with figures and celestial elements. The drawing depicts a central figure emerging from the clouds surrounded by a radiant light, while other figures are positioned below and around. The scene is enclosed within a circular border featuring floral and spiral patterns. The composition is detailed with shading and contrasts, suggesting a narrative or mythological element. The circular format and elaborate border may indicate that this piece is intended to resemble a medallion or cameo-like object.

artworks.title: Seige of Troy
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a detailed and intricate ornate scene featuring figures clad in armor, riding horses, and engaged in combat or a parade. The background is filled with elaborate decorative patterns and swirling motifs within an oval frame. The figures and decorative elements are densely packed, requiring careful observation to discern the various elements and actions within the artwork.

artworks.title: The Three Horatii
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a decorative circular emblem containing a group of figures in a historical setting. The artwork presents a central scene confined within an ornate circular frame. The detailed etching depicts several armored figures. The figures appear to be engaged in conversation or confrontation. Symmetrically positioned are more people, possibly soldiers or retainers. The edges are detailed with floral and scrollwork embellishments, including a dramatic motif of a face with wings at the bottom.

artworks.title: Time
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a classical scene set within a circular frame with Roman numerals. The central image depicts a muscular, nude figure standing beside a lion under a sky featuring a sun or celestial body emitting rays. In the background, there is a rustic house with a sloped roof. Surrounding this scene is a decorative border with Roman numerals, resembling a clock or timepiece, alongside intricate designs or patterning. The overall composition combines elements of mythology and symbolism, focusing on balance and harmony between human, nature, and celestial imagery.

artworks.title: Antonio Vassilacchi
artworks.description: The portrait shows a man from the chest up, turned slightly to his left but looking directly at the viewer. He has a defined facial structure with arched eyebrows, deep-set eyes, and a prominent nose. His hair is dark and short with a slight wave, and he has a full, neatly trimmed beard and mustache. He wears a dark jacket with a white collar. The background is a muted earthy tone with a subtle gradient that highlights the subject's face. The name "Antonio Vassilacchi" is inscribed below the portrait, along with additional notations.

artworks.title: Carlo Maratta
artworks.description: The image shows a man seated with his upper body turned slightly to the right. He has deep-set eyes, slightly furrowed brows, and closed lips. He has curly hair that reaches past his shoulders. He is wearing a dark cloak over a white shirt with a high collar visible at the neck. His hand rests on a book with a ribbon. The background is plain, with a soft, dark gradient emphasizing his presence in the image.

artworks.title: Cesare Nebbia
artworks.description: The image shows a man from the upper torso up, with a high forehead, receding brown hair, slightly curled above his ears, and a small goatee. The man looks directly at the viewer with a calm expression and slightly furrowed eyebrows. He is wearing a dark green coat with large buttons and a soft white collar, highlighted by light falling on it. There are no visible jewelry or objects in his hands. The background is a simple, muted brown tone. The name "Cesare Nebia" is inscribed on the lower section of the image, along with other text and numbers, partially cropped by the frame.

artworks.title: Ciro Ferri
artworks.description: This image features a head-and-shoulders portrait of a man facing forward with a slight turn to his right. He has long, dark, wavy hair, softly arched eyebrows, slightly deep-set eyes, a long, straight nose, and a faint smile. He wears a loose blue garment over a white shirt with an open collar. The background is a textured brown surface. Text at the lower edge identifies the person as Ciro Ferri and credits the creator as Laurino.

artworks.title: Claudio Ridolfi
artworks.description: The image features a portrait of a man displaying his upper body. He is positioned slightly turned towards the right, but his head is facing the viewer, allowing a clear view of his face. The man has distinctive facial features with a prominent moustache and a short goatee. His hair is medium brown, swept back. He is wearing a deep green garment with a high, wide white collar. There is no visible jewelry or objects in his hands. The background is a muted, dark tone.

artworks.title: Filippo d'Angeli
artworks.artist: Carlo Lasinio, after Teodoro Filippo di Liagno, called Napoletano
artworks.description: The image depicts a man with dark hair, a mustache, and a ruffled collar. He is facing forward with his head slightly turned, set against a dark background.

artworks.title: Giovanni Battista Salvi (Il Sassoferrato)
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of an individual's upper body, with a focus on the face and shoulders. The person faces forward with a slight tilt of the head to the right. They have a medium-length beard and mustache, short hair, light-colored eyes, and a fair complexion. The individual wears an outfit with a large white collar over a dark garment. The background is a uniform, muted blue. At the bottom, there is a label with the text "GIO: BATTA-SALVI".

artworks.title: Giovanni Mazzanti
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of a person's upper body including the head, neck, shoulders, and upper chest. The person is slightly turned to one side, looking into the distance. They have prominent eyebrows, a slightly tilted gaze, and a subtle, closed-mouth expression. The person has long, wavy, light brown hair flowing over their shoulders. They are wearing a dark robe with a white cloth around the neck, holding a long, slim object resembling a paintbrush. A red piece of fabric is draped over one arm. The background is a muted, dark color and the bottom of the image contains text, including the name "Giovanni Massanti."

artworks.title: Marco Benefial
artworks.description: The image shows an upper-body portrait of a person seated in a formal, semi-profile position. The individual has distinct facial features with a fair complexion, prominent full cheeks, and a slightly serious expression. They have long, curled, white powdered hair framing the face and covering the ears. The person is dressed in a formal blue robe with a white cravat. The background is a muted neutral tone. The name "MARCO. BENEFIAL" is inscribed below the portrait.

artworks.title: Mario Nuzzi
artworks.description: The image shows a painted portrait of a man's upper body. He is seated and facing slightly left towards the viewer. His face has a serene expression, with a straight nose and lightly defined eyebrows. He has brown shoulder-length wavy hair and is wearing a blue robe with a white undergarment visible at the neckline. In his right hand, he holds an object outside the frame. The background is a simple, muted brown color.

artworks.title: Michelangelo Ricciolini
artworks.description: The image is a bust-length portrait of a person in a three-quarter view, with only the upper part of their body visible. The individual is positioned slightly to the side, with the head turned to face the viewer. They have a light complexion with distinctive facial features, including a slightly furrowed brow and a focused expression. Their hair is curly and dark brown, and they are wearing a hat with decorative elements along its band. The person is dressed in a dark, voluminous drapery with a hint of a white shirt underneath that has a ruffled collar. There is no visible jewelry. The background is a plain, brownish tone. The bottom of the image contains text identifying the subject as "MICH-AN: RICCIOLINI."
